title: Item
description: A thing the player can carry. Items were previously modelled as variables of kind "item" — booleans with no name, description, or asset to bind, which made them the only referenced thing in the format with no human-facing identity. Possession itself is runtime state (GameState.inventory), not a field here: this registry says what an item IS, and give_item / take_item / the item condition say whether you have one.

name.description: Player-facing display name, e.g. "Stable Lantern". This is the reason the entity exists.

description.description: Player-facing description — what the item is, as the player would read it in an inventory.
